title: Micromeritics Instrument Corp.
content: Micromeritics Instrument Corp. is a U.S. supplier of gas adsorption, BET surface area, porosity, and particle characterization instrumentation. These capabilities are directly relevant to aerogel materials development, where pore structure, surface area, and adsorption behavior are critical characterization metrics. Micromeritics is a strong Equipment Materials entry for laboratories and technical teams evaluating porous-material analysis tools in North America.
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
